stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

H=W=20
G=[[9]*W for _ in range(H)]
# upper-left component
pal=[4,0,2]
for r in range(7):
 for c in range(9):
  d=min(r,6-r,c,8-c)
  G[r][c]=pal[d%len(pal)]
# bottom-left component
pal2=[7,2]
for r in range(8,20):
 for c in range(9):
  d=min(r-8,19-r,c,8-c)
  G[r][c]=pal2[d%2]
# right component
for r in range(20):
 for c in range(10,20): G[r][c]=1
# divider lines
for r in range(20): G[r][9]=8
for c in range(10): G[7][c]=8
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,row)) for row in G))
